name: Default
shortDescription: Self-hosted music request and discovery app with a web player and Subsonic and Jellyfin APIs. This variant bundles no download client, so music arrives through drop imports or download plugins.

alerts.message: The first account created in the web UI becomes the admin. Open the app right after deploying to claim it, then add /data/music as the library path under Settings > Library.
No download client is included, and one on another server cannot hand its files to this stack. Requests wait until you add a download plugin or use the slskd variant; drop imports work without one.
